        "originalContents": "# Storybook Documentation Standards\n\n## Story Structure and Organization\n\n### Story File Naming\n\n- **Co-locate stories** with component files\n- **Use component name** + &#96;.stories.tsx&#96; extension\n- **Group related stories** in the same file\n- **Export stories** as named exports\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Proper story file structure\n// PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx\nimport type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'\nimport {PersonnelFileCard} from './PersonnelFileCard'\n\nconst meta: Meta\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e = {\n  title: 'Documents/PersonnelFileCard',\n  component: PersonnelFileCard,\n  parameters: {\n    layout: 'centered',\n  },\n  tags: ['autodocs'],\n}\n\nexport default meta\ntype Story = StoryObj\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e\n\nexport const Default: Story = {\n  args: {\n    personnel: {\n      id: '1',\n      name: 'John Smith',\n      classification: 'secret',\n      date: '1963-05-15',\n      rank: 'Captain',\n      serviceNumber: '12345',\n      organization: 'NASA',\n    },\n  },\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Story Organization\n\n- **Group by feature** in Storybook sidebar\n- **Use consistent naming** for story variants\n- **Include comprehensive examples** for all props\n- **Document edge cases** and error states\n\n## Component Documentation\n\n### Meta Configuration\n\n- **Set appropriate title** for component grouping\n- **Configure layout** (centered, fullscreen, etc.)\n- **Enable autodocs** for automatic documentation\n- **Add tags** for categorization and search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Comprehensive meta configuration\n",
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "column": 2,
            "line": 63
          },

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\nconst fg = require(\"fast-glob\");\nconst fs = require(\"node:fs\");\nconst path = require(\"node:path\");\n\n// Get all .tsx component files under src/features/case-files that are not story files\nconst files = fg.sync([\n\t\"src/features/case-files/**/*.tsx\",\n\t\"!src/features/case-files/**/*.stories.tsx\",\n]);\n\nfor (const file of files) {\n\tconst ext = path.extname(file);\n\tconst baseName = path.basename(file, ext);\n\tconst dir = path.dirname(file);\n\tconst storyFile = path.join(dir, &#96;${baseName}.stories.tsx&#96;);\n\n\t// Skip if story file already exists\n\tif (fs.existsSync(storyFile)) {\n\t\tconsole.log(&#96;Story already exists for ${file}&#96;);\n\t\tcontinue;\n\t}\n\n\t// Convert kebab-case filename to PascalCase component name\n\tconst componentName = baseName\n\t\t.split(\"-\")\n\t\t.map((s) =\u003e s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1))\n\t\t.join(\"\");\n\tconst title = &#96;@case-files/${baseName}&#96;;\n\n\t// Create the story file content\n\tconst content = &#96;import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react'\nimport { ${componentName} } from './${baseName}'\n\nconst meta: Meta\u003ctypeof ${componentName}\u003e = {\n  title: '${title}',\n  component: ${componentName},\n}\n\nexport default meta\n\ntype Story = StoryObj\u003ctypeof ${componentName}\u003e\n\nexport const Default: Story = {\n  render: () =\u003e \u003c${componentName} /\u003e,\n}\n&#96;;\n\n\tfs.writeFileSync(storyFile, content);\n\tconsole.log(&#96;Created story: ${storyFile}&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "\u003cDocumentLibrary\n  documents={[...documents]}\n  searchable={true}\n  filterByClassification={true}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Classification System\n\n### Security Levels\n- **UNCLASSIFIED** (Green): Public information\n- **CONFIDENTIAL** (Yellow): Limited access required\n- **SECRET** (Orange): National security sensitive\n- **TOP SECRET** (Red): Highest classification level\n\n### Visual Indicators\n- Color-coded badges with rotation effects\n- Border styling variations\n- Typography weight adjustments\n- Background tint modifications\n\n## Storybook Integration\n\nAll components include comprehensive Storybook stories:\n- Component variations and states\n- Interactive controls for all props\n- Accessibility testing scenarios\n- Usage documentation and examples\n\nView stories: &#96;bun run storybook&#96;\n\n## Accessibility Features\n\n- Semantic HTML structure\n- ARIA labels for classification levels\n- High contrast text/background ratios\n- Keyboard navigation support\n- Screen reader friendly content structure\n\n## Component Development\n\n### Creating New Documents\n1. Extend &#96;BaseDocumentData&#96; interface in &#96;types.ts&#96;\n2. Create component following &#96;VintageDocumentCard&#96; patterns\n3. Add Storybook stories with comprehensive examples\n4. Export from appropriate &#96;index.ts&#96; files\n\n### Styling Guidelines\n- Use design system color variables\n- Implement hover/focus states\n- Add subtle animations (≤300ms)\n- Maintain vintage aesthetic consistency\n- Test accessibility contrast ratios\n\n## Integration Notes\n\n- Components work with existing mindmap/research systems\n- Compatible with dark/light theme switching\n- Optimized for responsive layouts\n- Integrates with database document models\n\n## File Structure Reference\n\nKey files for component development:\n- &#96;types.ts&#96;: Type definitions\n- &#96;VintageDocumentCard.tsx&#96;: Base component\n- &#96;*.stories.tsx&#96;: Storybook documentation\n- &#96;research-image-assets/&#96;: Vintage textures and imagery\n- &#96;case-file-docs.css&#96;: Specialized styling",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "\u003cDocumentLibrary"

            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "/\u003e"

            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"

            "lineNumber": 123

            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "## Classification System"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,

        "contents": "\n\nconst SwipeGrid = ({\n  items,\n  children,\n}: {\n  items: SwipeGridItem[]\n  children: any\n}) =\u003e {\n  const grid = useRef\u003cany\u003e(null)\n  const gridWrap = useRef\u003cany\u003e(null)\n\n  const hasRun = useRef(false)\n\n  const applyAnimation = () =\u003e {\n    // Register Scroll Triggren\n    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)\n\n    // Child elements of grid\n    const gridItems = grid.current?.querySelectorAll('.grid__item')\n    const gridItemsInner = [...gridItems].map((item) =\u003e\n      item.querySelector('.grid__item-inner')\n    )\n\n    // Define GSAP timeline with ScrollTrigger\n    const timeline = gsap.timeline({\n      defaults: { ease: 'none' },\n      scrollTrigger: {\n        trigger: gridWrap.current,\n        start: 'top bottom+=5%',\n        end: 'bottom top-=5%',\n        scrub: true,\n        // markers: true // Optional: for debugging\n      },\n    })\n\n    grid.current.style.perspective = '1000px'\n    grid.current.style.width = 'calc(1 / 0.65 * 100%)'\n    grid.current.style.height = 'calc(1 / 0.5 * 100%)'\n\n    timeline\n      .set(gridWrap.current, {\n        rotationY: 25,\n      })\n      .set(gridItems, {\n        z: () =\u003e gsap.utils.random(-1600, 200),\n      })\n      .fromTo(\n        gridItems,\n        { xPercent: () =\u003e gsap.utils.random(-1000, -500) },\n        { xPercent: () =\u003e gsap.utils.random(500, 1000) },\n        0\n      )\n      .fromTo(gridItemsInner, { scale: 2 }, { scale: 0.5 }, 0)\n  }\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    //make sure we run this function only once\n    if (!hasRun.current \u0026\u0026 grid.current) {\n      applyAnimation()\n      window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })\n      hasRun.current = true\n    }\n  }, [grid])",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# GSAP Animation Quick Start Guide\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Navigate to the app directory and run:\ncd apps/app\npnpm add gsap@^3.12.5 @gsap/react@^2.1.0\n\n# Or use the provided script:\n./src/layouts/home/install-gsap.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📁 Created Files\n\n1. **&#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;** - Core animation logic hook\n2. **&#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;** - Animated home layout component\n3. **&#96;TitleAltGSAP.tsx&#96;** - Enhanced title with letter animations\n4. **&#96;HomeComparison.tsx&#96;** - A/B testing component\n5. **&#96;home-animated/page.tsx&#96;** - Sample page implementation\n\n## ⚡ Usage Options\n\n### Option 1: View Animated Version\n\nNavigate to: &#96;/home-animated&#96;\n\n### Option 2: A/B Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeComparison } from '@/layouts/home/HomeComparison'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeComparison /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 3: Replace Default Home\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeGSAP } from '@/layouts/home/home-gsap'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeGSAP /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎯 Important Update Required\n\nIn &#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;, update line 2:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\nimport {TitleAlt} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAlt'\n\n// To this:\nimport {TitleAltGSAP} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAltGSAP'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAnd update the component usage on line 68:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\n\u003cTitleAlt /\u003e\n\n// To this:\n\u003cTitleAltGSAP /\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎨 Animation Features\n\n- **Staggered Entrance**: Each element enters with carefully timed delays\n- **3D Letter Animation**: Title letters rotate in 3D space\n- **Elastic Effects**: Moon and Earth use elastic easing for organic feel\n- **Continuous Motion**: Post-entrance animations keep the scene alive\n- **Mouse Parallax**: Elements respond to cursor movement\n- **Scroll Effects**: Earth scales based on scroll position\n- **GPU Optimization**: All animations use transform/opacity for 60fps\n\n## 🔧 Customization\n\nModify timings in &#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;:\n\n- Entrance duration: Line 36-39\n- Stagger delays: Timeline position parameters\n",

        "originalContents": "# GSAP Animation Quick Start Guide\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Navigate to the app directory and run:\ncd apps/app\npnpm add gsap@^3.12.5 @gsap/react@^2.1.0\n\n# Or use the provided script:\n./src/layouts/home/install-gsap.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📁 Created Files\n\n1. **&#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;** - Core animation logic hook\n2. **&#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;** - Animated home layout component\n3. **&#96;TitleAltGSAP.tsx&#96;** - Enhanced title with letter animations\n4. **&#96;HomeComparison.tsx&#96;** - A/B testing component\n5. **&#96;home-animated/page.tsx&#96;** - Sample page implementation\n\n## ⚡ Usage Options\n\n### Option 1: View Animated Version\n\nNavigate to: &#96;/home-animated&#96;\n\n### Option 2: A/B Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeComparison } from '@/layouts/home/HomeComparison'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeComparison /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 3: Replace Default Home\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeGSAP } from '@/layouts/home/home-gsap'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeGSAP /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎯 Important Update Required\n\nIn &#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;, update line 2:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\nimport {TitleAlt} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAlt'\n\n// To this:\nimport {TitleAltGSAP} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAltGSAP'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAnd update the component usage on line 68:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\n\u003cTitleAlt /\u003e\n\n// To this:\n\u003cTitleAltGSAP /\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎨 Animation Features\n\n- **Staggered Entrance**: Each element enters with carefully timed delays\n- **3D Letter Animation**: Title letters rotate in 3D space\n- **Elastic Effects**: Moon and Earth use elastic easing for organic feel\n- **Continuous Motion**: Post-entrance animations keep the scene alive\n- **Mouse Parallax**: Elements respond to cursor movement\n- **Scroll Effects**: Earth scales based on scroll position\n- **GPU Optimization**: All animations use transform/opacity for 60fps\n\n## 🔧 Customization\n\nModify timings in &#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;:\n\n- Entrance duration: Line 36-39\n- Stagger delays: Timeline position parameters\n",

1].offsetWidth\n    const getUseableHeight = () =\u003e document.documentElement.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight\n    const getDraggableWidth = () =\u003e ( track.offsetWidth * 0.5 ) - lastItemWidth()\n\n    // Create the main timeline animation\n    const tl = gsap.timeline()\n      .to( track, {\n        x: () =\u003e getDraggableWidth() * -1,\n        ease: 'none'\n      } )\n\n    // Create ScrollTrigger\n    const st = ScrollTrigger.create( {\n      animation: tl,\n      scrub: 0,\n    } )\n\n    // Create Draggable instance\n    const updatePosition = () =\u003e {\n      const left = track.getBoundingClientRect().left * -1\n      const width = getDraggableWidth()\n      const useableHeight = getUseableHeight()\n      const y = gsap.utils.mapRange( 0, width, 0, useableHeight, left )\n      st.scroll( y )\n    }\n\n    const draggableInstance = Draggable.create( track, {\n      type: 'x',\n      inertia: true,\n      bounds: {\n        minX: 0,\n        maxX: getDraggableWidth() * -1\n      },\n      edgeResistance: 1,\n      onDragStart: () =\u003e st.disable(),\n      onDragEnd: () =\u003e st.enable(),\n      onDrag: updatePosition,\n      onThrowUpdate: updatePosition\n    } )",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const useHomeAnimations = () =\u003e {\n  const refs: AnimationRefs = {\n    container: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    moon: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    earth: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    nav: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    title: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    stars: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    shootingStars: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    cursor: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n  }\n\n  useGSAP( () =\u003e {\n    // Register GSAP plugins if needed\n    // gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, etc.)\n\n    // Create main timeline\n    const tl = gsap.timeline( {\n      defaults: {\n        ease: 'power3.out',\n        duration: 1.2\n      },\n      onComplete: () =\u003e {\n        // Start continuous animations after intro\n        startContinuousAnimations()\n      }\n    } )\n\n    // Set initial states\n    gsap.set( [\n      refs.moon.current,\n      refs.earth.current,\n      refs.nav.current,\n      refs.title.current,\n      refs.stars.current,\n      refs.shootingStars.current,\n      refs.cursor.current\n    ], {\n      opacity: 0,\n      scale: 0.8,\n    } )\n\n    // Specific initial states\n    gsap.set( refs.moon.current, {\n      y: -200,\n      rotation: -180,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.earth.current, {\n      scale: 0,\n      rotation: -90,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.nav.current, {\n      y: -100,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.title.current, {\n      scale: 0.5,\n      y: 50,\n    } )",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const useHomeAnimations = () =\u003e {\n  const refs: AnimationRefs = {\n    container: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    moon: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    earth: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    nav: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    title: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    stars: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    shootingStars: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n    cursor: useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null ),\n  }\n\n  useGSAP( () =\u003e {\n    // Register GSAP plugins if needed\n    // gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, etc.)\n\n    // Create main timeline\n    const tl = gsap.timeline( {\n      defaults: {\n        ease: 'power3.out',\n        duration: 1.2\n      },\n      onComplete: () =\u003e {\n        // Start continuous animations after intro\n        startContinuousAnimations()\n      }\n    } )\n\n    // Set initial states\n    gsap.set( [\n      refs.moon.current,\n      refs.earth.current,\n      refs.nav.current,\n      refs.title.current,\n      refs.stars.current,\n      refs.shootingStars.current,\n      refs.cursor.current\n    ], {\n      opacity: 0,\n      scale: 0.8,\n    } )\n\n    // Specific initial states\n    gsap.set( refs.moon.current, {\n      y: -200,\n      rotation: -180,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.earth.current, {\n      scale: 0,\n      rotation: -90,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.nav.current, {\n      y: -100,\n    } )\n\n    gsap.set( refs.title.current, {\n      scale: 0.5,\n      y: 50,\n    } )",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Animated Background Component\n\n## Overview\nA complex animated SVG background component that creates a futuristic grid system with animated lines, circles, and geometric shapes.\n\n## Key Features\n- **Animated Grid Lines**: Horizontal and vertical lines that grow from zero width\n- **Intersection Circles**: Small circles that fade in at grid intersections\n- **Geometric Shapes**: Animated rectangles and paths with stroke animations\n- **Gradient Effects**: Multiple linear and radial gradients for visual depth\n- **Backdrop Filters**: Blur effects on circle elements\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Animation System\n- Uses Framer Motion for all animations\n- Four main animation variants:\n  - &#96;rectGrowVariants&#96;: For growing line animations\n  - &#96;circleVariants&#96;: For circle fade-in and stroke drawing\n  - &#96;dashVariants&#96;: For geometric shape stroke animations\n  - &#96;lineVariants&#96;: For path drawing animations\n\n### Component Structure\n- **SVG Container**: Fixed positioned, centered background element\n- **Gradient Definitions**: Complex gradient system for visual effects\n- **Filter Definitions**: Backdrop blur filters for depth\n- **Animated Elements**: Motion components for each animated element\n\n### Data Flow\n1. Component mounts and sets &#96;isVisible&#96; to true\n2. All motion elements animate from \"hidden\" to \"visible\" state\n3. Different animation timings create staggered effect\n4. Animations run once on mount\n\n## Usage\n\\&#96;\\&#96;\\&#96;tsx\nimport AnimatedBackground from \"./AnimatedBackground\"\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"relative\"\u003e\n      \u003cAnimatedBackground /\u003e\n      {/* Your content */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\\&#96;\\&#96;\\&#96;\n\n## Customization\n- Modify animation durations in variant objects\n- Adjust gradient colors in SVG definitions\n- Change positioning via CSS classes\n- Add new animated elements following existing patterns\n",
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "import React, { useRef } from 'react'\n\nimport { configureAnimationSequence } from './functions.animations'\nimport { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'\n\nexport const AnimatedComponent = ({ animation, children }: any) =\u003e {\n  const animateInnerBlocks = animation?.animateInnerBlocks || false\n  const ref = useRef(null)\n\n  const {\n    initial,\n    whileInView,\n    duration = 1,\n    delay = 0,\n  }: any = configureAnimationSequence(animation)\n\n  return (\n    \u003cAnimatePresence\n    // initialState={configureAnimationSequence(animation)}\n    \u003e\n      {!animation || animateInnerBlocks ? (\n        \u003c\u003e{children}\u003c/\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cmotion.div\n          transition={{\n            duration: duration,\n            amount: 'some',\n            repeatType: 'reverse',\n            ease: 'easeIn',\n            delay,\n          }}\n          initial={initial}\n          whileInView={whileInView}\n          ref={ref}\n        \u003e\n          {children}\n        \u003c/motion.div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/AnimatePresence\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "# GSAP Animation Quick Start Guide\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Navigate to the app directory and run:\ncd apps/app\npnpm add gsap@^3.12.5 @gsap/react@^2.1.0\n\n# Or use the provided script:\n./src/layouts/home/install-gsap.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📁 Created Files\n\n1. **&#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;** - Core animation logic hook\n2. **&#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;** - Animated home layout component\n3. **&#96;TitleAltGSAP.tsx&#96;** - Enhanced title with letter animations\n4. **&#96;HomeComparison.tsx&#96;** - A/B testing component\n5. **&#96;home-animated/page.tsx&#96;** - Sample page implementation\n\n## ⚡ Usage Options\n\n### Option 1: View Animated Version\n\nNavigate to: &#96;/home-animated&#96;\n\n### Option 2: A/B Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeComparison } from '@/layouts/home/HomeComparison'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeComparison /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 3: Replace Default Home\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeGSAP } from '@/layouts/home/home-gsap'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeGSAP /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎯 Important Update Required\n\nIn &#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;, update line 2:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\nimport {TitleAlt} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAlt'\n\n// To this:\nimport {TitleAltGSAP} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAltGSAP'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAnd update the component usage on line 68:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\n\u003cTitleAlt /\u003e\n\n// To this:\n\u003cTitleAltGSAP /\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎨 Animation Features\n\n- **Staggered Entrance**: Each element enters with carefully timed delays\n- **3D Letter Animation**: Title letters rotate in 3D space\n- **Elastic Effects**: Moon and Earth use elastic easing for organic feel\n- **Continuous Motion**: Post-entrance animations keep the scene alive\n- **Mouse Parallax**: Elements respond to cursor movement\n- **Scroll Effects**: Earth scales based on scroll position\n- **GPU Optimization**: All animations use transform/opacity for 60fps\n\n## 🔧 Customization\n\nModify timings in &#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;:\n\n- Entrance duration: Line 36-39\n- Stagger delays: Timeline position parameters\n",
        "detailedLines": [

        "originalContents": "# GSAP Animation Quick Start Guide\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Navigate to the app directory and run:\ncd apps/app\npnpm add gsap@^3.12.5 @gsap/react@^2.1.0\n\n# Or use the provided script:\n./src/layouts/home/install-gsap.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📁 Created Files\n\n1. **&#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;** - Core animation logic hook\n2. **&#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;** - Animated home layout component\n3. **&#96;TitleAltGSAP.tsx&#96;** - Enhanced title with letter animations\n4. **&#96;HomeComparison.tsx&#96;** - A/B testing component\n5. **&#96;home-animated/page.tsx&#96;** - Sample page implementation\n\n## ⚡ Usage Options\n\n### Option 1: View Animated Version\n\nNavigate to: &#96;/home-animated&#96;\n\n### Option 2: A/B Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeComparison } from '@/layouts/home/HomeComparison'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeComparison /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 3: Replace Default Home\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeGSAP } from '@/layouts/home/home-gsap'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeGSAP /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎯 Important Update Required\n\nIn &#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;, update line 2:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\nimport {TitleAlt} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAlt'\n\n// To this:\nimport {TitleAltGSAP} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAltGSAP'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAnd update the component usage on line 68:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\n\u003cTitleAlt /\u003e\n\n// To this:\n\u003cTitleAltGSAP /\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎨 Animation Features\n\n- **Staggered Entrance**: Each element enters with carefully timed delays\n- **3D Letter Animation**: Title letters rotate in 3D space\n- **Elastic Effects**: Moon and Earth use elastic easing for organic feel\n- **Continuous Motion**: Post-entrance animations keep the scene alive\n- **Mouse Parallax**: Elements respond to cursor movement\n- **Scroll Effects**: Earth scales based on scroll position\n- **GPU Optimization**: All animations use transform/opacity for 60fps\n\n## 🔧 Customization\n\nModify timings in &#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;:\n\n- Entrance duration: Line 36-39\n- Stagger delays: Timeline position parameters\n",

Document upload and processing\n\n**🎛️ UI Primitives**\n\n- **&#96;cult-ui/&#96;** - Custom UI components\n- **&#96;hud-interface/&#96;** - HUD-style interfaces\n- **&#96;graph-paper/&#96;** - Grid and paper backgrounds\n- **&#96;glitch-fx/&#96;** - Visual effects and transitions\n\n#### **Technology Stack**\n\n- **Framework**: Next.js 15.3.5 with React 19.1.0\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4.1.11 with Radix UI\n- **3D**: Three.js, React Three Fiber, D3.js\n- **State**: Zustand, React Context\n- **Real-time**: Liveblocks, PartySocket\n- **AI**: Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic\n\n### 🧠 Disclosure RAG System (&#96;/apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;)\n\n**Purpose**: Advanced document processing and retrieval-augmented generation with triple RAG architecture\n\n#### **Core Architecture**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n📁 lib/\n├── 🔄 adapters/             # RAG system adapters\n│   ├── dual_rag_adapter.py          # Dual RAG implementation\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial Design System\n\nA comprehensive design system for UFO disclosure documents and dystopian interfaces, featuring aged paper aesthetics, classified document styling, and data visualization components.\n\n## Overview\n\nThis design system creates authentic-looking UFO/UAP disclosure documents with:\n- **Aged paper textures** and vintage document styling\n- **Classification markings** and redacted information effects  \n- **Data visualization** components for coordinates, timestamps, and case files\n- **Special effects** including glitch animations, blur filters, and scan lines\n- **Typography system** with handwritten annotations and monospace data\n- **Responsive layouts** optimized for document display\n\n## Core Principles\n\n1. **Authenticity**: Every component should feel like it belongs in a real classified document\n2. **Hierarchy**: Clear information hierarchy using typography, spacing, and color\n3. **Accessibility**: Maintain readability while preserving aesthetic effects\n4. **Consistency**: Unified color palette and spacing system throughout\n5. **Responsiveness**: Components work across all device sizes\n\n## Components\n\n### Typography System\n\nThe typography system provides specialized text components for document creation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { Typography, Heading, DataLabel, HandwrittenNote } from '@/components/design-system'\n\n// Main document heading\n\u003cHeading\u003eUFO DISCLOSURE PROJECT\u003c/Heading\u003e\n\n// Classified document heading  \n\u003cTypography variant=\"heading-classified\"\u003eTOP SECRET\u003c/Typography\u003e\n\n// Data labels and values\n\u003cDataLabel\u003eCASE FILE NO.\u003c/DataLabel\u003e\n\u003cDataValue\u003eUFO-1947-07-08-001\u003c/DataValue\u003e\n\n// Handwritten annotations\n\u003cHandwrittenNote rotation={-2}\u003e\n  \"Definitely not conventional aircraft\" - Agent Smith\n\u003c/HandwrittenNote\u003e\n\n// Special effects\n\u003cTypography variant=\"redacted\"\u003e████████████\u003c/Typography\u003e\n\u003cTypography glitch\u003eSIGNAL CORRUPTED\u003c/Typography\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Typography Variants\n\n- **heading-main**: Large, bold document titles\n",

        "originalContents": "# Ultraterrestrial Design System\n\nA comprehensive design system for UFO disclosure documents and dystopian interfaces, featuring aged paper aesthetics, classified document styling, and data visualization components.\n\n## Overview\n\nThis design system creates authentic-looking UFO/UAP disclosure documents with:\n- **Aged paper textures** and vintage document styling\n- **Classification markings** and redacted information effects  \n- **Data visualization** components for coordinates, timestamps, and case files\n- **Special effects** including glitch animations, blur filters, and scan lines\n- **Typography system** with handwritten annotations and monospace data\n- **Responsive layouts** optimized for document display\n\n## Core Principles\n\n1. **Authenticity**: Every component should feel like it belongs in a real classified document\n2. **Hierarchy**: Clear information hierarchy using typography, spacing, and color\n3. **Accessibility**: Maintain readability while preserving aesthetic effects\n4. **Consistency**: Unified color palette and spacing system throughout\n5. **Responsiveness**: Components work across all device sizes\n\n## Components\n\n### Typography System\n\nThe typography system provides specialized text components for document creation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { Typography, Heading, DataLabel, HandwrittenNote } from '@/components/design-system'\n\n// Main document heading\n\u003cHeading\u003eUFO DISCLOSURE PROJECT\u003c/Heading\u003e\n\n// Classified document heading  \n\u003cTypography variant=\"heading-classified\"\u003eTOP SECRET\u003c/Typography\u003e\n\n// Data labels and values\n\u003cDataLabel\u003eCASE FILE NO.\u003c/DataLabel\u003e\n\u003cDataValue\u003eUFO-1947-07-08-001\u003c/DataValue\u003e\n\n// Handwritten annotations\n\u003cHandwrittenNote rotation={-2}\u003e\n  \"Definitely not conventional aircraft\" - Agent Smith\n\u003c/HandwrittenNote\u003e\n\n// Special effects\n\u003cTypography variant=\"redacted\"\u003e████████████\u003c/Typography\u003e\n\u003cTypography glitch\u003eSIGNAL CORRUPTED\u003c/Typography\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Typography Variants\n\n- **heading-main**: Large, bold document titles\n",

        "contents": "# Research UI Components\n\n**Specialized document presentation components for the Ultraterrestrial Research Platform**\n\n## Overview\n\nThe Research UI component library provides authentic, vintage-styled document components designed to present UAP/UFO research materials with historical accuracy and atmospheric immersion. Components simulate classified documents, incident reports, personnel files, and archival materials.\n\n## Core Philosophy\n\n- **Historical Authenticity**: Visual designs based on real declassified documents\n- **Information Hierarchy**: Clear presentation of sensitive/classified information\n- **Immersive Experience**: Vintage document styling with aging effects\n- **Accessibility**: Screen reader support with semantic markup\n- **Modularity**: Composable components for flexible document layouts\n\n## Architecture\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nresearch-ui/\n├── documents/               # Core document components\n│   ├── types.ts            # TypeScript interfaces\n│   ├── VintageDocumentCard.tsx    # Base document container\n│   ├── IncidentReportCard.tsx     # Incident report specialization\n│   ├── PersonnelFileCard.tsx      # Personnel file specialization\n│   └── CaseFileFolder.tsx         # Case file organization\n├── case-file-ui/           # Case file specific components\n├── crash-retrievals/       # Crash retrieval documentation\n├── notes/                  # Handwritten note components\n├── report-files/           # Official report presentations\n└── research-image-assets/  # Vintage imagery and textures\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Component Categories\n\n### 1. Document Foundation\n- **VintageDocumentCard**: Base container with classification badges, aging effects, and vintage styling\n- **ClassificationBadge**: Security classification indicators (Unclassified → Top Secret)\n- **TopSecretBanner**: Full-width classification headers\n\n### 2. Specialized Documents\n- **IncidentReportCard**: UFO sighting and encounter reports\n",

        "contents": "\n# ULTRATERRESTRIAL RESEARCH PLATFORM DESIGN SYSTEM\n\n\u003e **Last Updated**: August 9, 2025  \n\u003e **Version**: 2.0  \n\u003e **Status**: Production Ready  \n\n## Install GSAP and ScrollTrigger:**\n\nInstall GSAP and its ScrollTrigger plugin:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install gsap\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**3. Develop the Animated Book Component:**\n\nCreate a new file named &#96;AnimatedBook.js&#96; in the &#96;src&#96; directory:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;jsx\n// src/AnimatedBook.js\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { gsap } from 'gsap';\nimport { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';\nimport './AnimatedBook.css';\n\ngsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);\n\nconst AnimatedBook = () =\u003e {\n  const bookRef = useRef(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const book = bookRef.current;\n\n    gsap.fromTo(\n      book,\n      { opacity: 0, y: 50 },\n      {\n        opacity: 1,\n        y: 0,\n        scrollTrigger: {\n          trigger: book,\n          start: 'top 80%',\n          end: 'top 50%',\n          scrub: true,\n        },\n      }\n    );\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"book\" ref={bookRef}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"page\"\u003ePage 1\u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"page\"\u003ePage 2\u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"page\"\u003ePage 3\u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default AnimatedBook;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**4. Style the Component:**\n\nCreate a CSS file named &#96;AnimatedBook.css&#96; in the &#96;src&#96; directory:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* src/AnimatedBook.css */\n.book {\n  width: 200px;\n  height: 300px;\n  perspective: 1000px;\n}\n\n.page {\n  width: 100%;\n  height: 100%;\n  background-color: #fff;\n  border: 1px solid #ccc;\n  position: absolute;\n  transform-origin: left center;\n  transition: transform 0.5s;\n}\n\n.page:nth-child(1) {\n  transform: rotateY(0deg);\n}\n\n.page:nth-child(2) {\n  transform: rotateY(-120deg);\n}\n\n.page:nth-child(3) {\n  transform: rotateY(-240deg);\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**5. ### Component
Create `apps/app/src/components/animated/animated-book/AnimatedBook.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client'

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import './animated-book.css'

export type AnimatedBookProps = {
  pageCount?: number
}

export function AnimatedBook({ pageCount = 12 }: AnimatedBookProps) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const book = rootRef.current?.querySelector('.book')
      if (!book) return

      gsap.to(book, {
        scrollTrigger: {
          scrub: 1,
          start: 0,
          end: () => window.innerHeight * 0.25,
        },
        scale: 1,
      })

      const pages = Array.from(
        rootRef.current!.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.book__page')
      )

      pages.forEach((page, index) => {
        gsap.set(page, { z: index === 0 ? 13 : -index })

        if (index === pageCount - 1) return

        gsap.to(page, {
          rotateY: `-=${180 - index / 2}`,
          scrollTrigger: {
            scrub: 1,
            start: () => (index + 1) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
            end: () => (index + 2) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
          },
        })

        gsap.to(page, {
          z: index === 0 ? -13 : index,
          scrollTrigger: {
            scrub: 1,
            start: () => (index + 1) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
            end: () => (index + 1.5) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
          },
        })
      })
    }, rootRef)

    return () => ctx.revert()
  }, [pageCount])

  const pages = Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, i) => i + 1)

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="animated-book-root">
      <div className="book">
        <div className="book__spine" />
        {pages.map((n) => {
          const isFrontCover = n === 1
          const isBackCover = n === pageCount
          const classes = [
            'page',
            'book__page',
            isFrontCover ? 'book__cover book__cover--front' : '',
            isBackCover ? 'book__cover book__cover--back' : '',
          ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(' ')

          return (
            <div
              key={n}
              className={classes}
              style={{ ['--page-index' as any]: n }}
            >
              <div className="page__half page__half--front">
                <div className="page__number">{n * 2 - 1}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="page__half page__half--back">
                <div className="page__number">{n * 2}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="scroll-spacer" aria-hidden />
    </div>
  )
}
```

Create `apps/app/src/components/animated/animated-book/animated-book.css`:
```css
.animated-book-root {
  --page-count: 12;
  --page-scroll: 25; /* vh per segment */
  --underline: rgba(64,64,64,0.4);
  --spine: #000;
  --cover: #1a1a1a;
  --bg: #4d4d4d;
  --insert: #d9d9d9;
  --page: #e6e6e6;
  position: relative;
}

.animated-book-root .scroll-spacer {
  width: 100%;
  height: calc(((var(--page-count) + 2) * var(--page-scroll)) * 1vh);
}

.book {
  height: 40vmin;
  width: 30vmin;
  min-width: 150px;
  min-height: 200px;
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.5);
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  perspective: 1200px;
}

.book__spine {
  height: 100%;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  position: absolute;
  background: var(--spine);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  width: 12px;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, -13px) scaleX(1) rotateY(0deg);
}

.book__page {
  position: absolute;
  left: 2%;
  top: 50%;
  border-radius: 0 5% 5% 0;
  transform: translate(0, -50%);
  height: 94%;
  width: 94%;
  z-index: calc(((var(--page-count) + 2) - var(--page-index)) * 2);
  transform-origin: 0% 50%;
}

.book__cover {
  border-radius: 0 5% 5% 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0;
  background: var(--cover);
}

.book__cover--front .page__half--back {
  border-right: 1rem solid var(--spine);
}

.book__cover--back .page__half--front {
  border-left: 1rem solid var(--spine);
}

.page {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}

.page__half {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  transform: rotateY(calc(var(--rotation, 0) * 1deg)) translate3d(0, 0, calc((0.5 * var(--coefficient, 0)) * 1px));
  -webkit-clip-path: inset(0 0.5% 0 0.5%);
  clip-path: inset(0 0.5% 0 0.5%);
}

.page__half--front {
  --rotation: 0;
  --coefficient: 0;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  border-radius: 0 5% 5% 0;
}

.page__half--back {
  --rotation: 180;
  --coefficient: 2;
  border-radius: 5% 0 0 5%;
}

.book__page:not(.book__cover) .page__half {
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 1rem, var(--underline) 1rem calc(1rem + 1px), transparent calc(1rem + 1px)) 0 1rem/100% 100% no-repeat,
    var(--page);
}

.page .page__number {
  position: absolute;
  color: #808080;
  bottom: 1rem;
  font-size: 1vmin;
}
.page__half--front .page__number { right: 1rem; }
.page__half--back .page__number { left: 1rem; }
```

---
title: Firestarter – RAG Chatbot Generator (Comprehensive Guide)
description: End‑to‑end documentation for MendableAI Firestarter including architecture, setup, configuration, API, deployment, MCP/Context7 integration, and troubleshooting.
created: 2025-08-10T00:00:00Z
lastUpdated: 2025-08-10T00:00:00Z
author: Ultraterrestrial Research Platform
version: 1.0.0
---

# Firestarter

Firestarter instantly creates AI chatbots for any website using a modern RAG stack with streaming responses and an OpenAI‑compatible API.

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/firestarter
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/firestarter-rag-chatbot-generator

## 1) Overview

- **Goal**: Enter a URL → crawl → index → chat over site content.
- **Core stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), Vercel AI SDK (streaming), Firecrawl (crawl/clean Markdown), Upstash Search (vectors), multi‑provider LLMs (OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq).
- **Outputs**:
  - Web UI for chatbot creation and querying
  - Per‑namespace RAG index
  - OpenAI‑compatible `/api/v1/chat/completions` endpoint for each chatbot

## 2) Architecture

- Crawl: Firecrawl API fetches pages → normalized Markdown
- Index: Upstash Search chunks + embeds to vectors (by namespace)
- Query: Retrieve top K chunks → system prompt → LLM → stream to UI
- Namespacing: Per chatbot isolation for documents/embeddings
- API: OpenAI‑compatible chat endpoint per namespace (model aliasing)

Sequence:
1. Submit URL → server creates namespace
2. Firecrawl crawl job → Markdown pages
3. Index to Upstash Search (chunk+embed)
4. UI/SDK queries → retrieve → LLM → stream

## 3) Prerequisites

- Node 18+ / Bun ok if repo supports
- Accounts/keys:
  - Firecrawl API
  - Upstash Search (REST URL/token)
  - At least one LLM provider key (OpenAI or Anthropic or Groq)
- Vercel optional (recommended)

## 4) Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mendableai/firestarter
cd firestarter
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local
# Fill keys
npm run dev
```

### 4.1 Environment

```
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=...
UPSTASH_SEARCH_REST_URL=...
UPSTASH_SEARCH_REST_TOKEN=...
# Pick at least one:
OPENAI_API_KEY=...
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...
GROQ_API_KEY=...
```

### 4.2 Configuration

`firestarter.config.ts` controls crawl limits, provider priority, and feature flags (e.g., enableCreation). Adjust namespace policies and retrieval params (topK, similarity threshold) as needed.

## 5) Usage

- Visit `http://localhost:3000`
- Create chatbot: enter URL → start → wait for crawl/index
- Query: ask questions in UI; responses stream
- Programmatic: use OpenAI SDK with baseURL to Firestarter’s `/api/v1/chat/completions`, model name = generated namespace alias.

Example (JS):
```ts
import OpenAI from 'openai'

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'any', // Firestarter handles auth server-side
  baseURL: 'https://your-firestarter.vercel.app/api/v1/chat/completions'
})

const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'firecrawl-example-com-12345',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'What is Firecrawl?' }],
})
console.log(completion.choices[0].message.content)
```

## 6) RAG Configuration

- Chunk size/overlap: tune per content type (docs vs blogs)
- Embeddings model: pick provider that matches Upstash Search defaults
- Retrieval: topK 4–12 typical; raise for longer answers
- Prompting: keep system prompt “grounded; cite sources; no hallucinations”
- Namespace TTL: optional cleanup policy for ephemeral bots

## 7) MCP and Context7 Integration

- Firecrawl MCP:
  - Use MCP tool for URL ingestion and crawl status retrieval.
  - Recommended workflow: enqueue crawl → poll status → write normalized Markdown into Firestarter ingestion pipeline (or directly to Upstash Search; ensure namespace consistency).
- Context7:
  - Use as external knowledge context provider; forward retrieved chunks from Context7 to Firestarter’s LLM layer (bypassing internal retrieval) by plugging into the “retrieval override” hook.
- Suggested server action:
  - Implement a Server Action `ingestExternalDocs({ namespace, docs[] })` to accept pre‑scraped items from MCP/Context7 jobs.

## 8) Deployment

- Vercel: zero‑config Next.js + serverless functions
- Set env vars in Vercel dashboard
- Increase crawl limits for self‑hosted (see `firestarter.config.ts`)
- CDN/Edge cache UI, keep API dynamic
- Scale: Upstash Search is serverless; Firecrawl is external SaaS

## 9) Observability

- Log: request ids, namespace, provider, tokens used
- Metrics: crawl durations, indexing throughput, search latency, tokens per answer
- Traces: enable Vercel AI SDK events, LLM streaming markers

## 10) Security & Compliance

- Verify domain ownership for public deployments to prevent abuse
- Rate‑limit chatbot creation and query endpoints
- Respect robots.txt and site TOS in crawling
- PII: avoid persisting chats by default; redact logs

## 11) Troubleshooting

- Crawl returns empty: verify Firecrawl key and robots.txt
- No results: confirm namespace and that indexing completed
- 401 on API: baseURL correct, deployment URL matches
- Slow answers: reduce topK or chunk size; check provider latency
- Hallucinations: tighten prompt; lower temperature; increase grounding

## 12) Roadmap (suggested)

- Multi‑tenancy auth + quotas
- Per‑namespace prompt/versioning
- Source highlighting inline
- Feedback loop (helpfulness, citations valid)

## 13) References

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/firestarter
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/firestarter-rag-chatbot-generator
```

# Firecrawl Observer

Monitor any web page for content changes with visual diffs and intelligent alerts.

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/firecrawl-observer
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/introducing-firecrawl-observer

## 1) Overview

- **Goal**: Track changes on target URLs; be notified when meaningful updates occur.
- **Core stack**: Next.js + Convex (as referenced), Firecrawl for fetch/normalize, AI significance scoring, visual diff viewer.
- **Use cases**: Docs updates, pricing pages, product changes, government releases.

## 2) Architecture

- Scheduler triggers fetch via Firecrawl
- Normalize content → markdown/blocks
- Diff engine produces semantic/visual diff
- AI significance filter classifies “trivial” vs “meaningful”
- Notification channels: email/webhook; UI dashboard

## 3) Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mendableai/firecrawl-observer
cd firecrawl-observer
npm install
cp .env.local.example .env.local
# Fill keys (Firecrawl, email/webhook providers, Convex if used)
npm run dev
```

### 3.1 Environment

Common variables:
```
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=...
NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL=...
EMAIL_PROVIDER_KEY=...
CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT=... # if applicable
```

## 4) Usage

- Add URL monitor with schedule (seconds → weeks)
- Choose change scope (full page vs selector subset)
- Configure notifications (webhook/email)
- Review diff: side‑by‑side HTML/Markdown; view AI summary

## 5) Diffing & Significance

- Heuristics: ignore timestamps, counters, A/B fragments
- AI layer: model classifies change significance and tags summary
- Thresholds: adjustable for sensitivity (e.g., ignore < N characters)

## 6) MCP and Context7 Integration

- Firecrawl MCP:
  - Use MCP to batch‑register monitors; store job ids; standardized crawl payloads for reproducibility.
- Context7:
  - Push diffs to Context7 as “events” for downstream research; embed event payload (old/new snippets, URL, time).
- Suggested webhooks:
  - `POST /api/observer/webhook` receives change events with `{ url, detectedAt, significance, summary, diffUrl }`.

## 7) Deployment

- Self‑host (Vercel/Node runtime). Ensure scheduler/cron is configured.
- Persist history (Convex/DB): store snapshots, diffs, labels.
- Secrets via env; rotate keys.

## 8) Observability

- Metrics: checks per hour, success rate, average fetch time
- Alerts: repeated failures per URL
- Audit: change history export (CSV/JSON)

## 9) Security

- Rate limits per origin
- Respect robots.txt and cache headers
- Allowlist for internal deployments

## 10) Troubleshooting

- Frequent false positives: expand ignore selectors; raise thresholds
- Missing changes: lower thresholds; ensure route not client‑rendered only
- 4xx/5xx: check target site anti‑bot rules; apply polite headers/backoff
- Email not delivered: verify provider and domain settings

## 11) Roadmap (suggested)

- Per‑selector diff granularity
- Screenshot diff layer
- Multi‑tenant/projects
- SLA alerts (critical pages)

## 12) References

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/firecrawl-observer
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/introducing-firecrawl-observer
```

# Open Researcher

Real‑time thinking, split‑view analysis, and automatic citations for deep web research.

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/open-researcher
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/open-researcher-interleaved-thinking

## 1) Overview

- **Goal**: Provide transparent, sourced research with live reasoning and side‑by‑side evidence.
- **Core stack**: Next.js UI + Firecrawl (fetch), Claude/OpenAI/Groq (LLMs), Vercel AI SDK (stream), citation builder.
- **Unique**: Interleaved thinking (exposes planning vs synthesis), auto citations, multi‑pane reading.

## 2) Architecture

- Query planner generates sub‑tasks
- Retriever fetches web sources (via Firecrawl)
- Reader ranks snippets → context window
- LLM composes answer with citations; thoughts rendered live
- UI panes: results list, active sources, draft, final

## 3) Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mendableai/open-researcher
cd open-researcher
npm install
cp .env.local.example .env.local
# Fill LLM keys + Firecrawl
npm run dev
```

### 3.1 Environment

```
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=...
OPENAI_API_KEY=... # or
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... # or
GROQ_API_KEY=...
```

## 4) Usage

- Enter research question
- Watch planner → retrieval → drafting with live tokens
- Inspect sources; open split view to compare claims
- Export answer + citations (markdown)

## 5) Prompting & Citations

- System prompt enforces: “Use only cited sources; avoid speculation”
- Auto‑citation format: `[n] Title (domain) – URL`
- Deduplicate sources and include access timestamps
- Temperature low for factual synthesis

## 6) MCP and Context7 Integration

- Firecrawl MCP:
  - Batch ingest curated corpora (PDFs, docs sites) as pre‑indexed sources.
- Context7:
  - Use as external memory store for previous findings; seed planner with prior nodes.
- Hook:
  - `ingestExternalSources({ topicId, docs[] })` server action to register external artifacts and citations.

## 7) Deployment

- Vercel recommended; enable streaming
- Configure domain/cors for browser source previews
- Persist research sessions for auditability (optional)

## 8) Observability

- Track tokens, provider, latency
- Log citations per answer
- Error budgets for failed fetches

## 9) Security & Ethics

- Respect site terms and robots.txt
- Cite all claims; mark uncertainty
- Disallow unsafe content; filter PII

## 10) Troubleshooting

- Empty results: broaden query; verify Firecrawl
- Hallucinations: strengthen instruction; increase retrieved K; lower temp
- Broken citations: validate URLs; re‑rank snippets

## 11) Roadmap (suggested)

- Multi‑agent debate
- Judgment with toolformer feedback
- Workspace memory graph
- Rich PDF ingestion pipeline

## 12) References

- Repo: https://github.com/mendableai/open-researcher
- Blog: https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/open-researcher-interleaved-thinking
```

### Exa Search API quick integration

- **Docs link**: [Exa Search API reference](https://docs.exa.ai/reference/search?auth_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJuYW1lIjoiTGlhbSBFbGxpcyIsImVtYWlsIjoibGlhbUBsaWFtZWxsaXMuZGV2IiwiYXBpS2V5IjoiY2Q0MDNhNGUtYWYyMy00ZjI3LWIxMDctZWI3M2JkODE1YThjIiwidmVyc2lvbiI6MSwiaWF0IjoxNzU0ODQyMjIwfQ.jnCUxE7io1kn5x7GfoGhS8KkrU4L79sqavoxnGGOwHM)

- **Endpoint**: `POST https://api.exa.ai/search`
- **Auth**: header `x-api-key: YOUR-EXA-API-KEY`
- **Common payload**:
  - `query: string`
  - `text: true` to include extracted page text
- **Response**: `results[]` with `title`, `url`, `publishedDate`, `text` (if requested), `highlights`, `summary`, `subpages`, etc.

Code samples

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.exa.ai/search' \
  -H 'x-api-key: $EXA_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"Latest research in LLMs","text":true}'
```

```ts
// TypeScript (Next.js/Node)
const EXA_API = 'https://api.exa.ai/search'

type ExaSearchResult = {
  title: string
  url: string
  publishedDate?: string
  text?: string
  highlights?: string[]
  summary?: string
  subpages?: Array<{ url: string; title?: string; text?: string }>
}

export async function exaSearch(query: string, withText = true) {
  const res = await fetch(EXA_API, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'x-api-key': process.env.EXA_API_KEY!,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query, text: withText }),
  })
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Exa search failed: ${res.status}`)
  const data = await res.json()
  return (data.results || []) as ExaSearchResult[]
}
```

Integration tips

- **Open Researcher**: use `text` and `summary` fields as retrieval snippets; map to citations `{title, url, publishedDate}` and render highlights in split view. Lower temperature; enforce “answers must cite.”
- **Firestarter**: use Exa to discover relevant URLs, then hand URLs to your crawler/indexer (Firecrawl) by namespace before chatbot creation, or ingest Exa `text` directly if you trust extraction.
- **Observer**: seed monitored URL sets from Exa queries; store `url` + `publishedDate` to prioritize fresh sources.

Notes

- Keep `EXA_API_KEY` in env; never commit tokens.
- For larger excerpts, prefer setting `text: true` on search results to avoid separate fetches.
- Review Exa pricing fields in the response (`costDollars`) to budget calls.

Reference

- Exa Search API: [docs.exa.ai/reference/search](https://docs.exa.ai/reference/search?auth_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJuYW1lIjoiTGlhbSBFbGxpcyIsImVtYWlsIjoibGlhbUBsaWFtZWxsaXMuZGV2IiwiYXBpS2V5IjoiY2Q0MDNhNGUtYWYyMy00ZjI3LWIxMDctZWI3M2JkODE1YThjIiwidmVyc2lvbiI6MSwiaWF0IjoxNzU0ODQyMjIwfQ.jnCUxE7io1kn5x7GfoGhS8KkrU4L79sqavoxnGGOwHM)
